mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.user_id, u.username, u.name, u.phone, w.project_id, w.worker_type, w.entry_date, w.exit_date, w.status, w.is_deleted, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM t_temp_worker w LEFT JOIN t_user u ON w.user_id = u.id WHERE w.project_id = #{projectId} AND w.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY w.entry_date DESC

SELECT w.id, w.user_id, u.username, u.name, u.phone, w.project_id, w.worker_type, w.entry_date, w.exit_date, w.status, w.is_deleted, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM t_temp_worker w LEFT JOIN t_user u ON w.user_id = u.id WHERE w.id = #{id} AND w.is_deleted = 0

SELECT w.id, w.user_id, u.username, u.name, u.phone, w.project_id, w.worker_type, w.entry_date, w.exit_date, w.status, w.is_deleted, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM t_temp_worker w LEFT JOIN t_user u ON w.user_id = u.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_temp_worker (user_id, project_id, worker_type, entry_date, status, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{workerType}, #{entryDate}, #{status}, #{isDeleted}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_temp_worker SET worker_type = #{workerType}, entry_date = #{entryDate}, exit_date = #{exitDate}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_temp_worker SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
